run_clipseg_segmentation: run CLIPSeg object segmentation on an image using text prompts on Intel Gaudi HPU
run_clipseg_with_hpu_graphs: run CLIPSeg inference with HPU graphs enabled for better latency on Gaudi hardware
run_clipseg_bf16_inference: run CLIPSeg image segmentation using bf16 precision autocast on the HPU device
run_clipseg_benchmark: run CLIPSeg inference benchmarking with configurable warmup and iteration counts to measure latency
run_clipseg_save_segmented_images: run CLIPSeg segmentation and save thresholded segmented images as PNG files for each prompt
